svg.title: Protocol Chaos: Tools change. Your matters stay.
svg.desc: Seven things a person said to different AI assistants are scattered on the left. Six are threaded into a tidy tree of matters on the right: “See more of the world” holds “Lisbon trip, spring 2027”, and the trip and “Street photography” both hold “A 35mm lens”. One assistant’s guess about the trip is drawn dashed, marked as an inference. A passing question stays unthreaded.
